name: Dusklight
subtitle: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess for Apple Vision Pro
localizedDescription: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess on Apple Vision Pro: the full GameCube game rendered natively on Metal, in a free-floating 2D window and a world-locked stereoscopic 3D mode with foveated rendering, spatial audio anchored to the screen, and live-tunable screen size, distance, and depth. Ships with no game content; you supply your own GameCube Twilight Princess disc image.
